extensions.description: Your open pull requests in the sidebar, grouped by what needs you: CI failing, changes requested, running, ready to merge. Click one for the failing checks.
extensions.setup: Nothing if the gh CLI is installed and logged in; otherwise set GITHUB_TOKEN or put a token in the extension's config.json.

extensions.setup: Nothing. Press Enable in the panel; it installs rtk with winget/brew if needed and turns the Claude hook on. Restart Mota once after a fresh install.
